feature: Panorama decoration beyond global world edges
baseline_reuse_note: Three 356px references were executed during this task before candidate compilation, then reused after full identity validation. They are not counted as fresh executions of the nine-case matrix.

visual_review.outdoor: The left margin continues the existing yellow floral ground and small tulip silhouettes. Native sky/clouds remain unchanged. No extra Yoshi, HUD or enemy appears.
visual_review.castle_left: Stone floor and ceiling continue beyond the former cut; the existing carved diagonal pattern is reflected within a 32px edge band. Foreground shape meets the original boundary without blank strips.
visual_review.castle_right: The right void becomes a continuous stone wall with existing palette and masonry. The pipe remains single and unaltered.
visual_review.caveat: Artwork continuation is decorative and does not enlarge collision or playable space; only global x<0 or x>=4096 is covered.

fixture_provenance.outdoor: The private level 0 entry is synthetic and documented separately; 360 frames of native entry followed by 100 actual LEFT inputs and 30 no-input frames reach the original x=8 wall. No player teleport in the measured replay.
fixture_provenance.castle_left: Natural previously validated castle traversal state followed by 100 actual LEFT inputs and 30 no-input frames; original x=8 stop retained.
fixture_provenance.castle_right: Natural previously validated right-edge castle state; 3+60 no-input frames include the original pipe transition. Three protected captured frames remain exact.

guard_scope.world_x: Decoration only for x < 0 or x >= 4096.
guard_scope.layers: Foreground BG0/BG1 only; authored BG2/BG3 remain unchanged.
guard_scope.fallback: Unsupported scenes, protected native windows and active Fuzzy tile deformation retain existing guarded presentation.
guard_scope.internal_rooms: Does not infer internal player walls from camera limits, empty map cells or scroll-prevention flags.

temporal_stability.purpose: Check the concrete per-frame cache concern: decoration must not disappear intermittently while the scene remains supported.
temporal_stability.scene: Outdoor left global wall, native player x=8 and camera x=0 throughout.
temporal_stability.animation_note: The source scenery remains animated; bit-identical consecutive margins are not required. Every post-warmup image retains decoration and an exact native center.
